Name: Earthy Cursor - For Earthy Recolour
Author: Jaynvel
Description:
[font=Tahoma]I’m excited to share my first mod with you all, and I truly hope you enjoy it! [/font]

[font=Tahoma]This can be viewed as an add-on to [/font][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13658]DaisyNiko's Earthy Interface[/url][font=Tahoma]. [/font]
[font=Tahoma]I made this because I really love this recolour and wanted to create a cursor that complements it. [/font]
[font=Tahoma]It isn't much but I really hope you all like it.﻿[/font]

[img]https://images2.imgbox.com/81/76/805eKMAT_o.png[/img]

[font=Tahoma]1. Download the[/font][b] [/b][font=Tahoma]mod file to your device[/font]
[font=Tahoma]2. Extract the [/font][font=Courier New].zip[/font][font=Tahoma] file[/font]
[font=Tahoma]3. Place it in your [/font][font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font][font=Tahoma] folder[/font]
[font=Tahoma]4. Run the game using [/font][font=Courier New]StardewModdingAPI.exe[/font]
[font=Tahoma]If you see your new cursor that means you succesfulyl installed the mod! Enjoy.
[/font]
